vetSays.line: 🛡️ Ernesto, Nikolai and the woman in her 30s met them at the door — 3 put down. Ernesto, Nikolai, the woman in her 30s are hurt.
🛡️ Ernesto, Claire, Mthunzi, Paolo and Nikolai met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Ernesto, Claire, Mthunzi, Paolo, Nikolai are hurt.
🛡️ Connor, Ernesto, Mthunzi, Paolo and Nikolai met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Connor, Ernesto, Paolo, Nikolai are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Mia strikes the Elder Nevermore.
The Elder Nevermore falls.
📺 Mia brought down Elder Nevermore. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Mia brought down Elder Nevermore. Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Connor, Mthunzi, Nikolai, Sofia and Mia met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Connor, Mthunzi, Nikolai, Sofia, Mia are hurt.
🛡️ Mthunzi, Nikolai and Sofia met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Nikolai, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oussama just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanting just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Nikolai was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Wanting taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Wanting: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Fireside lesson: Wanting passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
Wanting: "The european elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
🛡️ Wanting met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
🛡️ Wanting and Violet met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Wanting, Violet are hurt.

stripes flowing where no wind blows
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
